process_warc_wat_file: run the cc_matching module to parse a WARC or WAT file and output matched image-text pairs to JSON
parse_warc_with_curator: create a WARCCurator instance to parse WARC archive files and extract image URLs with alt text and title attributes
parse_wat_with_curator: create a WATCurator instance to parse WAT gzip files and extract image links with associated text metadata
substrmatch_data: run the substrmatch method on a CCCurator to perform multiprocessing substring matching of text against metadata entries
normalize_url: use the normalize_url class method to resolve relative URLs against a target URI and optionally strip query parameters
